يترايقون (form VI)
# يَتَرَايَقُونَ (yatarāyaqūna) /ja.ta.raː.ja.quː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of تَرَايَقَ (tarāyaqa)
# يُتَرَايَقُونَ (yutarāyaqūna) /ju.ta.raː.ja.quː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of تَرَايَقَ (tarāyaqa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
